# Repository workflows

Current workflows are indexed in [command inventory](../docs/reference/command-inventory.md#workflows). Core CI is generated by `tools/render_ci_workflow.py`; do not edit its output independently. Application, runtime, release and native workflows prove distinct scopes.

Native foundation has four jobs with separate proof boundaries. `static` checks exact packages, Expo compatibility, types, unit tests and public config. `android-development` compiles the Expo dev-client debug APK (`assembleDebug`, Metro required); on `main` it retains it as `inktrospect-android-dev-client-<sha>` for 14 days as compile evidence. `ios-simulator` builds the unsigned simulator app. `android-handoff` builds the standalone development APK with `assembleRelease`, verifies it with the repository verifier, `apkanalyzer` and `apksigner`, installs that exact APK on an API-36 emulator and drives the real Free journey with checksum-pinned Maestro 2.11.0 against a disposable PostgreSQL service, API and gated analysis worker, including force-stop/relaunch and exact duplicate-work counts. It never starts Metro. Pull requests only qualify. A successful `main` push alone publishes `inktrospect-android-handoff-<sha>` (APK, checksum, `BUILDINFO.json`, `HANDOFF.md`; 30 days); failures upload synthetic-only diagnostics for 5 days. None of these jobs is physical-device, signing, store or T31 evidence.

The Documentation handover workflow is read-only and runs standard-library source/link/inventory checks plus explicitly safe tests. It never executes every code fence. Record exact candidate/head and review limitations. Workflow configuration does not prove branch protection or external account authorization; confirm those in [access handover](../docs/handover/access-and-assets.md).
